At Villalobos Rescue Center, every dog deserves a chance at a better life. Tia Torres and her team are rescuing abandoned, injured and neglected pit bulls, while hoping to find them the loving families they deserve.
From heartwarming adoptions to emotional rescue stories, these dogs are proving that a little love can change everything. But who will open their heart and give them a forever home?
Watch Pit Bulls & Parolees, Season 7B, Episodes 12, 14, 16 & 20, and Season 8, Episodes 1, 2, 3 & 9 on Animal Planet India.
